title: aniflow explicit target-resolution policy v1
description: Closed integer-scale rule over both oriented dimensions of the current square, unrotated RGB8 frame input. Exact reaches the target when processing is needed; minimum selects the smallest supported 2x, 3x or 4x factor meeting it. Same-aspect input already at or above the target is preserved without downscale unless force_reprocess forbids bypass. No implicit crop, stretch, letterbox, fractional resize or 1x neural pass is supported. Geometry is not perceptual quality or native detail.
